title: Conditional point-addition timing in a scalar-multiplication controller
description: Analyze the cycle-timing and control-flow behavior of a small double-and-add scalar-multiplication controller across different input scalars, and propose an RTL remediation that equalizes timing while preserving correct outputs.

expected_output.summary: A single JSON report describing the scalar-dependent control path, per-bit cycle-timing signature across representative scalars, and a concrete RTL remediation that equalizes cycle count while preserving correct scalar-multiplication results.

metrics.name: leakage_detection_accuracy
metrics.description: Whether the report correctly identifies the scalar-dependent control state/signal responsible for the timing variation and supports this with cycle-count data correlated to the scalar's Hamming weight.

metrics.name: fault_coverage
metrics.description: Fraction of required cycle_counts_by_scalar entries (spanning low, mid, and high Hamming-weight scalars) that are present and numerically consistent with an independent simulation of the provided controller.

metrics.name: hardening_precision
metrics.description: Whether the proposed remediation concretely describes always executing the conditional operation with a discarded/dummy result and selecting the real result via a mux, and whether correctness preservation is asserted and justified.

metrics.name: format_conformance
metrics.description: Whether vulnerability_report.json satisfies the required JSON schema, with all fields present and of the correct type.
